title: Vention 45W 20000mAh CCC Certified Power Bank with Built-in Cable US$21.29 (~A$29.89) @ VEnTIOn Flagship Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: Vention 45W 20000mAh CCC Certified Power Bank with Built-in Cable US$21.29 (~A$29.89) @ VEnTIOn Flagship Store AliExpress

[daniel717] I’ve never made it to the INIU 45W built in cable deals but thank god I made it to this one. Still looks like a high quality one. Can someone provide me their thought on this and the INIU 45W built in cable power bank. Which is better and which they recommend?
Thanks Hippo!
[Ezekiel2320] Woohoo! Been eyeing these off for months since I don't use Prime and therefore never get the Inui deal.
Screw you Inui!
[Chazzozz] Thanks OP, I managed to snag one. I've got a tired old powerbank that needs decommissioning so this is a good replacement.
[asyik] Could someone please confirm if we can carry this onboard of an aeroplane? I thought there was a restriction of max 10000 mah
[bogak] You can carry them onboard but most won't allow you to use onboard the plane. Always check with whatever airline you're flying with as the rules may differ.
[squattington] I have this model and it will deliver 45w for about 20-30 minutes before heating up and lowering it's output
[Hiphopopotamus] Seems to be a common behaviour (I have read about INIU 45W power banks also doing this), what does it go down to?
[nixes] Yeah found similar feedback on reddit, this one seems like a dud: https://www.reddit.com/r/ChargingSheet/comments/1myxyyo/vent…
Apparently can only do 20w most of the time.
[omnipotenceBOS] Strangely it only costed AUD $21 with delivery. Is this right?
[yoquierotaco] I somehow got this (not a new account)…
$21.87 - ($3 + $4 coupon) + $2.42 tax + free shipping = $17.29 USD
Also 20% topcashback and 10% cashback as AliExpress credit
[PoKGuy] Just bought:
$17.39 USD for me with the listed coupons applied.
With the ~$4 AUD cashback from TopCashBack, which equates to $21 AUD net delivered (ETA: 20th Oct)
Yep, happy with this, thanks OP.
[CodeXD] Isn't there also an additional requirement for qr code?
[illusion99] For new powerbanks sold in China yes from March 2027. But if you have existing ccc non QR code powerbank you should be still ok to travel with it after March 2027. It’s more for selling powerbanks that they have to have QR codes now
[gadgetguy] Looks a bit chonky - can't see the weight mentioned anywhere, even in the online user manual.
[containsmsg] Still waiting for a deal on a 3C model with wireless charging
[Matcha] Is Aliexpress considered as international purchase? Just wondering if I'll be charged an international transaction fee by my credit card company…
